contract.known_boundary: Sandbox-aware filesystem boundary with scoped read/write, atomic replace and path capability semantics.
contract.detail_gap: No method-level API or certification criteria are authoritative yet; this proof does not invent them.

candidates.independence: Dart project package; independent from cellar_flutter.

fit.atomic_replace: not established by reviewed upstream evidence
fit.platform_notes: LocalFileSystem depends on dart:io. Required native targets are technically compatible with Dart/Flutter; Raspberry Pi remains Linux feasibility rather than explicit upstream Pi certification.

candidates.role: preferred architecture primitive pending deterministic dependency resolution

fit.generic_filesystem_abstraction: partial; object-storage facade rather than FileSystem
fit.scoped_paths: strong through validated key grammar and keyPrefix tenant scoping
fit.atomic_replace: strong; upstream documents atomic writes on every supported platform
fit.platform_notes: Explicit iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux and web support. Raspberry Pi remains Linux feasibility rather than explicit upstream Pi certification.

candidates.maturity: low; repository created in 2026 and adoption is still small
candidates.role: strong emerging alternative, not preferred over the mature primitive yet

decision.reason: The need is staged and the Library contract remains draft. The mature candidate also lacks deterministic vulnerability resolution at this release.
